title: kate-ui: bind ctrl-z to undo
summary: ctrl-z returns Undo. ctrl-shift-z and ctrl-y return Redo. cmd-z and shift-cmd-z stay as they are. The test goes in the existing keys tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

Do not add a second module with the same name. Edit only the match inside edit_binding. Add three arms next to the existing cmd-z arm. ctrl-z returns Some(Command::Undo). ctrl-shift-z returns Some(Command::Redo). ctrl-y returns Some(Command::Redo). Do not touch these functions: normalize_binding, command_for_binding, move_binding, text_binding, MOVE_BINDINGS, caret_marks, selection_spans, visible_selection_spans, reveal_line, scroll_y_for_line. It returns Command::Undo. command_for_binding of ctrl-shift-z returns Command::Redo. command_for_binding of shift-ctrl-z returns Command::Redo. command_for_binding of ctrl-y returns Command::Redo. command_for_binding of cmd-z still returns Command::Undo. command_for_binding of shift-cmd-z still returns Command::Redo. regression_tests.name: keys::tests::ctrl_z_undoes
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because ctrl-z returns None. After the change ctrl-z returns Undo. ctrl-shift-z, shift-ctrl-z, and ctrl-y return Redo. cmd-z still returns Undo. shift-cmd-z still returns Redo.
